name: What kind of storage features can be incorporated into a custom pantry?

mainEntity.name: What kind of storage features can be incorporated into a custom pantry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom pantries can incorporate a wide array of storage features to maximize organization and accessibility. Popular options include adjustable shelving for varying item heights, pull-out drawers for easy access to deeper items, spice racks, and specialized dividers for canned goods or bottles. You can also include dedicated spaces for small appliances, built-in wine racks, or even a countertop for prep work in larger walk-in designs. The selection of features is driven by your specific storage needs and the overall functionality you desire from your pantry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom pantries can include adjustable shelving, pull-out drawers, spice racks, appliance nooks, and wine storage to optimize organization.
